title: Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network: Explainable Deep Learning for Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2606.30953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce NBS-RASN, a novel hybrid neural architecture for explainable cybersecurity risk evaluation in open-source software ecosystems. Unlike conventional deep models that trade interpretability for predictive power, it uses a meticulously designed shallow network that encodes domain knowledge, causal reasoning, and expert judgment as differentiable components. The network has 80 interpretable neurons across 12 layers, including a gatekeeper layer enforcing five epistemological axioms-precision, causality, falsifiability, transparency, and completeness-as hard constraints before propagation. Despite limited depth, non-linear residual attention and feedback loops give it deep-learning characteristics, enabling complex context-dependent risk patterns without becoming a black box. translated_title: 神经-贝叶斯-符号残差注意力浅层网络：面向网络安全风险评估的可解释深度学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了NBS-RASN，这是一种用于开源软件生态系统中可解释网络安全风险评估的新型混合神经架构。与以牺牲可解释性来换取预测能力的传统深度模型不同，它采用了一个精心设计的浅层网络，将领域知识、因果推理和专家判断编码为可微分组件。该网络在12层中拥有80个可解释神经元，其中包括一个“守门员层”，在信息传播之前将五条认识论公理——精确性、因果性、可证伪性、透明性和完备性——作为硬约束加以强制执行。尽管网络深度有限，非线性残差注意力和反馈循环赋予其深度学习特性，使其能够捕捉复杂的、依赖上下文的风险模式，而不会沦为黑箱。它能够产生完全可分解的风险评分：由一个确定性加权分量加上一个专家调整分量组成，每一项调整均可追溯至……
tldr: 该论文提出NBS-RASN混合神经架构，通过将领域知识、因果推理和专家判断编码为浅层网络中的可微分组件，并以五条认识论公理作为硬约束，在保持风险评分完全可分解、可追溯的同时，实现了深度学习级别的网络安全风险评估能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NBS-RASN, a hybrid neural architecture that encodes domain knowledge, causal reasoning, and expert judgment as differentiable components in a shallow network governed by five epistemological axioms as hard constraints, achieving deep-learning-level cybersecurity risk assessment while keeping risk scores fully decomposable and traceable.
